Package com.example.gitcat_events.core.model

Class WaitListEntry

java.lang.Object
com.example.gitcat_events.core.model.Entry
com.example.gitcat_events.core.model.WaitListEntry
public class WaitListEntry extends Entry
Represent an entry in the waitlist for an event. This class extends the entry class to represent users who is on waitlist for the event.
